ten: Series · Zeus at Work (hoạt hình, tập 1 thử)
mo_ta: Series hoạt hình hài văn phòng: Zeus bị giáng chức xuống làm nhân viên quèn ở một công ty bảo hiểm Manhattan; mỗi tập một quyền năng thần thánh rò ra khi ông nổi nóng, còn sếp Linda bé nhỏ khó tính thật ra là Medusa. Tiếng Anh, toàn cầu.

kinh_thanh.phong_cach: Premium stylized 3D animated feature-film look, like a modern big-studio animated comedy: appealing exaggerated character designs with big expressive eyes, soft global illumination, warm rich colors, subsurface-scattered skin and soft fur, gentle rim light, shallow depth of field, crisp tactile materials, cinematic composition for a vertical 9:16 frame. Clean frames with no text, letters or logos anywhere.
kinh_thanh.logline: Zeus wants to survive his first day at the office without causing a single 'incident', but his lightning leaks out every time the machines and his manager push him.
kinh_thanh.chu_de: Even a god has to learn humility — and you can't control everything

series.dong_co: Zeus, demoted from Olympus to an entry-level job at a Manhattan insurance office, tries to survive one ordinary workday per episode — but one divine power leaks out every time he loses his temper, and his tiny, ruthless manager Linda (secretly Medusa) is always watching.
series.khan_gia: adults 18–34 who like office comedy and Greek mythology (global, English)
series.dinh_dang: YouTube Shorts / TikTok, 45–60s vertical, 3 episodes a week; every 4 episodes compiled into a long video

tap.logline: Zeus wants to survive his first day at the office without causing a single 'incident', but his lightning leaks out every time the machines and his manager push him.
After learning his manager is Medusa, Zeus wants to apologize to the whole office, but his thunder voice shatters every window whenever he gets emotional.
Zeus wants to win the office trust-fall day to impress Linda, but his old habit of turning into animals keeps catching him mid-fall.
Zeus wants to hide his new job from his wife Hera when she drops by with lunch, but every coworker he lies to turns out to be a god in disguise.
Zeus wants a perfect performance review, but Linda's stare literally turns his excuses — and his chair — to stone.
Zeus wants to fit in on casual Friday, but the only casual clothes he owns are a golden toga and a crown that won't come off.
Zeus wants to train the new intern properly, but the intern is Hermes, who delivers every email before it's even written.
Zeus wants to lead the office fire drill, but the 'fire warden' is Prometheus and he brought real fire.
Zeus wants a quiet coffee, but his brother Poseidon visits the breakroom and the water cooler starts a tsunami.
Zeus finally gets the call to return to Olympus, but leaving means abandoning the office misfits — and Linda — who became his real family.

nhan_vat.mo_ta: Zeus as a stylized 3D animated character: huge broad-shouldered man in his 60s, enormous fluffy white beard and wild white hair that crackles with tiny blue static sparks, thick white eyebrows, bright storm-blue eyes, big round nose, ill-fitting white office shirt straining at the buttons, short navy tie with a yellow lightning-bolt pattern, grey slacks, a plastic ID badge on a lanyard reading only a photo; proud, dramatic, secretly insecure

Linda as a stylized 3D animated character: very short, sharp middle-aged office manager, pale olive skin, tight dark-green hair bun, large black cat-eye sunglasses worn indoors, emerald blazer and pencil skirt, red lipstick, clipboard always in hand; icy, unimpressed, terrifyingly calm

A dull open-plan insurance office in a Manhattan high-rise: grey fabric cubicles, beige carpet, buzzing fluorescent ceiling panels, a beat-up printer and a coffee machine by the wall, tall windows with a grey city skyline, cubicle 14B with a tiny desk and a too-small swivel chair

Linda's small glass-walled manager office in the corner of the insurance floor: spotless black desk, a single snake plant, a framed 'Employee of the Month' poster, blinds half closed, cold white light

tap.brief: Tập 1 của series 'Zeus at Work' (Shorts ~50s, hài văn phòng, tiếng Anh, khán giả 18–34 toàn cầu). Hook: Vua các vị thần ngồi cubicle 14B. Vấn đề: sếp Linda ra luật 'một sự cố là nghỉ'. Leo thang: máy in, máy cà phê, rồi deadline — mỗi lần sét rò mạnh hơn. Lật ngược: tia sét lớn làm cúp điện cả toà nhà, nhưng ánh sét của ông lại là đèn duy nhất và bản báo cáo kịp in. Móc: Linda tháo kính — tóc bà là rắn: 'We need to talk.' → tập 2.
